card_title: Anthropic Challenges Department of War Supply Chain Risk Designation
card_summary: Anthropic plans to fight in court after being labeled a national security supply chain risk by the Department of War.

card_title: Anthropic refuses Pentagon demands on autonomous weapons and surveillance
card_summary: Anthropic rejects military requests to allow mass surveillance and autonomous weapons, vows to fight back in court.

card_title: Anthropic Refuses Pentagon Demand to Remove AI Safety Safeguards
card_summary: Anthropic says it won't drop two AI safety limits despite Pentagon threats to remove Claude from military systems.

card_title: Anthropic Launches Claude Sonnet 4.6 With Major Coding and Computer Use Upgrades
card_summary: Anthropic's new Claude Sonnet 4.6 improves coding, computer use, and reasoning with a 1M token context window.

card_title: Anthropic pledges to keep Claude permanently ad-free
card_summary: Anthropic commits to never showing ads in Claude, saying advertising would undermine trust and helpfulness.
